import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
    target_output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Columns expected in target and sources (all identical)
    columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

    # Confirm columns are exactly the same in both sources and match target schema
    # (Given by prompt, so no renaming needed)

    # Because both sources have exactly the same schema as the target,
    # we can UNION (concatenate) them directly.

    # Concatenate source dataframes vertically (union)
    df_all = pd.concat([df0, df1], ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure data types match target schema:
    # According to target schema:
    # 'tripduration': integer
    # 'starttime': string
    # 'stoptime': string
    # 'start station id': integer
    # 'start station name': string
    # 'start station latitude': float
    # 'start station longitude': float
    # 'end station id': integer
    # 'end station name': string
    # 'end station latitude': float
    # 'end station longitude': float
    # 'bikeid': integer
    # 'usertype': string
    # 'birth year': integer
    # 'gender': integer

    # Convert columns to correct types, coercing errors to NaN where applicable
    df_all['tripduration'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['tripduration'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_all['starttime'] = df_all['starttime'].astype(str)
    df_all['stoptime'] = df_all['stoptime'].astype(str)
    df_all['start station id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['start station id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_all['start station name'] = df_all['start station name'].astype(str)
    df_all['start station latitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['start station latitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df_all['start station longitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['start station longitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df_all['end station id'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['end station id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_all['end station name'] = df_all['end station name'].astype(str)
    df_all['end station latitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['end station latitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df_all['end station longitude'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['end station longitude'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df_all['bikeid'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['bikeid'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_all['usertype'] = df_all['usertype'].astype(str)
    df_all['birth year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['birth year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df_all['gender'] = pd.to_numeric(df_all['gender'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly (just in case)
    df_all = df_all[columns]

    # Save the combined dataframe to the target CSV path without the index
    df_all.to_csv(target_output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
